title: CXReasonAgent: Evidence-Grounded Diagnostic Reasoning Agent for Chest X-rays
abstract: arXiv:2602.23276v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Chest X-ray plays a central role in thoracic diagnosis, and its interpretation inherently requires multi-step, evidence-grounded reasoning. However, large vision-language models (LVLMs) often generate plausible responses that are not faithfully grounded in diagnostic evidence and provide limited visual evidence for verification, while also requiring costly retraining to support new diagnostic tasks, limiting their reliability and adaptability in clinical settings. translated_title: CXReasonAgent：面向胸部X光的基于证据的诊断推理智能体
translated_abstract: 胸部X光检查在胸部疾病诊断中占据核心地位，其解读本质上需要多步骤、基于证据的推理。然而，大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）常常生成看似合理却并未忠实基于诊断证据的回答，且提供的视觉证据有限、难以验证，同时需要昂贵的重新训练才能支持新的诊断任务，这限制了其在临床环境中的可靠性与适应性。为解决这些局限，我们提出了CXReasonAgent，一个将大语言模型（LLM）与临床诊断工具相集成的诊断智能体，利用图像衍生的诊断证据和视觉证据来执行基于证据的诊断推理。为评估这些能力，我们引入了CXReasonDail，一个涵盖12个诊断任务、共1,946段对话的多轮对话基准，结果表明CXReasonAgent生成的回答更加忠实地基于诊断证据……
tldr: 该论文提出CXReasonAgent，一个结合大语言模型与临床诊断工具的智能体，通过图像衍生的诊断证据和视觉证据对胸部X光进行基于证据的多步诊断推理，并构建了包含1,946段多轮对话、覆盖12个诊断任务的基准CXReasonDail，证明其回答比大型视觉语言模型更忠实于证据且无需昂贵的重新训练即可适应新任务。
en_tdlr: CXReasonAgent is an evidence-grounded diagnostic reasoning agent that integrates an LLM with clinically grounded tools for chest X-ray interpretation, evaluated on CXReasonDail, a multi-turn dialogue benchmark of 1,946 dialogues across 12 diagnostic tasks, demonstrating more faithfully grounded responses than LVLMs without costly retraining.
